title: Patient Identity Conflict — Dual Numbering Detected

fields.organization: Ottawa River Regional Medical Center — Registration
fields.location: ED Triage Area, Registration Desk, Tower A Lobby
fields.summary: Two trauma patients on the paper tracking board have duplicate identifiers: T-6 (male, 34) was registered at the front desk as DT-004112 by a clerk who had not been briefed on the trauma number protocol. T-9 (female, 29) has a wristband labeled DT-004118, but the paper tracking board lists her as T-9. Additionally, a male crash victim with no ID is being held in the triage bay and may be the same individual as a patient registered by his brother using the name 'James M.' and a birth date that matches the T-6 profile. The Registration Department is using three blocks of DT numbers and has not synchronized with the HCC.

findings.item: Trauma number (T-) assigned on paper tracking board
findings.notes: Used as per C1 and ORRMC-DT-ANX-2026, Section 3

findings.item: DT- number assigned via paper registration
findings.notes: Two patients registered with DT- numbers without cross-checking against trauma numbers
DT-004112 and DT-004118 on wristbands conflict with T-6 and T-9 on tracking board
No verification performed by two staff on the same patient

findings.item: Registration clerk awareness of downtime protocol
findings.notes: Clerk not informed of trauma number protocol during downtime activation
No real-time sync between paper tracking board and registration database

findings.item: Patient with no ID in triage
findings.notes: Unidentified male patient in triage bay, possible duplicate identity with T-6
DT- series used in parallel with T- series without central coordination
Brother registered a patient, but no verification of identity
HCC not notified of dual numbering; board not updated to reflect DT- to T- mapping

actionsTaken: Notified HCC and EDMD via intercom at 17:50
Paused issuance of new DT- numbers until cross-reference complete
Assigned a second nurse to verify all wristbands and tracking board entries
Initiated a one-time cross-reference of T- and DT- numbers under supervision of the CNO
recommendations: Immediately suspend use of dual numbering series; standardize on T- for trauma patients and DT- for registration-only
Require dual verification by two staff for all patient IDs at bedside and on wristbands
Notify Chief Privacy Officer per ORRMC-DT-ANX-2026, Section 5
Document all duplicate identities for later reconciliation and audit
fields.photosNote: 3 photos attached: IMG_0412-0414 (wristband DT-004112, tracking board T-6, paper registration form), IMG_0415 (wristband DT-004118, tracking board T-9), IMG_0416 (unidentified male in triage, brother holding ID card)

instructorNote: This inject introduces a critical patient safety and privacy risk. The CNO and EDMD must halt dual numbering, enforce verification, and alert the CPO. Watch for delays in protocol enforcement or attempts to bypass verification.
